attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculates Nebraska state income tax per Form 1040N. Nebraska uses progressive tax brackets: 2.46% on first bracket, 3.51% on second bracket, 5.01% on third bracket, 5.20% on fourth bracket. Brackets differ by filing status. Starting with federal AGI, applies standard deduction based on filing status, then calculates tax using progressive brackets.

initial_action.action_postfix: "NEBRASKA FORM 1040N - State Income Tax Calculation" job.audit_trail swap addto result.agi /result.ne_agi xdef 0 /result.ne_bracket_1_tax xdef 0 /result.ne_bracket_2_tax xdef 0 /result.ne_bracket_3_tax xdef 0 /result.ne_bracket_4_tax xdef

/result.ne_standard_deduction xdef " Standard Deduction (MFJ): $" result.ne_standard_deduction cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto result.ne_agi result.ne_standard_deduction f- 0 fmax /result.ne_taxable_income xdef " NE Taxable Income: $" result.ne_taxable_income cvs strconcat " (AGI - Std Deduction)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto result.ne_taxable_income ne_bracket_4_threshold_mfj f> if ne_bracket_2_threshold_mfj ne_bracket_1_rate f* /result.ne_bracket_1_tax xdef ne_bracket_3_threshold_mfj ne_bracket_2_threshold_mfj f- ne_bracket_2_rate f* /result.ne_bracket_2_tax xdef ne_bracket_4_threshold_mfj ne_bracket_3_threshold_mfj f- ne_bracket_3_rate f* /result.ne_bracket_3_tax xdef result.ne_taxable_income ne_bracket_4_threshold_mfj f- ne_bracket_4_rate f* /result.ne_bracket_4_tax xdef " Bracket 1 (2.46% on $0-$8,040): $" result.ne_bracket_1_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto " Bracket 2 (3.51% on $8,040-$48,250): $" /result.ne_bracket_1_tax xdef ne_bracket_3_threshold_mfj ne_bracket_2_threshold_mfj f- ne_bracket_2_rate f* /result.ne_bracket_2_tax xdef result.ne_taxable_income ne_bracket_3_threshold_mfj f- ne_bracket_3_rate f* /result.ne_bracket_3_tax xdef " Bracket 1 (2.46% on $0-$8,040): $" result.ne_bracket_1_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto " Bracket 2 (3.51% on $8,040-$48,250): $" result.ne_bracket_2_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto " Bracket 3 (5.01% on $48,250-$" result.ne_taxable_income cvs strconcat "): $" strconcat result.ne_bracket_3_tax cvs strconcat strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto else result.ne_taxable_income ne_bracket_2_threshold_mfj f> if ne_bracket_2_threshold_mfj ne_bracket_1_rate f* /result.ne_bracket_1_tax xdef result.ne_taxable_income ne_bracket_2_threshold_mfj f- ne_bracket_2_rate f* /result.ne_bracket_2_tax xdef " Bracket 1 (2.46% on $0-$8,040): $" result.ne_bracket_1_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto " Bracket 2 (3.51% on $8,040-$" result.ne_taxable_income cvs strconcat "): $" strconcat result.ne_bracket_2_tax cvs strconcat strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto else result.ne_taxable_income ne_bracket_1_rate f* /result.ne_bracket_1_tax xdef " Bracket 1 (2.46% on $0-$" result.ne_taxable_income cvs strconcat "): $" strconcat result.ne_bracket_1_tax cvs strconcat strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto endif endif endif result.ne_bracket_1_tax result.ne_bracket_2_tax f+ result.ne_bracket_3_tax f+ result.ne_bracket_4_tax f+ /result.ne_tax xdef " Total NE Tax: $" result.ne_tax cvs strconcat " (Form 1040N)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto
